snippet.title: Krusty Cook-Off - Extra Krusty Edition - Get Cookin’ - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Join SpongeBob and his friends on a fun and fast-paced cooking adventure through the restaurants and kitchens of Bikini Bottom in SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off - Extra Krusty Edition, out now on Nintendo Switch!

Cook-up delicious dishes to hungry patrons in iconic locations like The Krusty Krab, Weenie Hut Jr’s and more! Plus, with the Nintendo Switch exclusive Extra Krusty Edition you’ll get 4 new power-ups to help you serve with speed and style!

Available Now! https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/spongebob-krusty-cook-off-switch/
